messages:
maria gonzalez: Quick heads-up — planning to cut v0.15.0 across api/runtime/console/sdk tomorrow 2026-03-18 16:00 PT. Need quick go/no-gos.

samir patel: Are there any contract changes in API? I skimmed PRs.

matthew (eng-runtime): runtime: only kv-cache fix + perf patch. No schema changes. Will need runtime bump to 0.15.1 if we include the hotfix as a separate roll, but v0.15.0 is fine if we backmerge.

eva li: console depends on a small header rename in API PR #6142 — non-breaking for most clients but SDKs will need a patch. I can coordinate the console side.

riyad ahmad: sdk update: python/js tests failing on master because of the header rename. PR #4023 updates types and test fixtures. ETA to merge: ~2h. If merged before freeze, SDKs can ship with v0.15.0; otherwise SDKs become v0.15.1 next week.

maria gonzalez: Proposed plan: freeze code at 15:30 PT, run cross-repo smoke tests (runbook: https://redwood/release/runbook), cut tags at 16:00 PT, and trigger release pipelines. Can owners confirm readiness by 15:00 PT?

samir patel: I'll prioritize API reviews and call out blockers by 14:45.

matthew (eng-runtime): :thumbsup: Runtime CI is green. I'll prep a quick backport branch in case we decide to include the hotfix separately.

eva li: I'll queue the console PRs and update the changelog entry with a note about the header rename and migration steps.

riyad ahmad: merging #4023 now, pushing test wheel and npm tarball to staging. Will post artifact links when done.

deploy-bot: Automated check: cross-repo CI status: api=passing, runtime=passing, console=flaky (2 tests), sdk=unstable (tests failing). See https://ci.redwood/release/3509123456

maria gonzalez: Okay — action items: @samir review API, @riyad merge SDK PR and publish staging artifacts, @eva update console changelog and validate UI smoke, @matthew prep runtime backport. If any can't hit 15:00 PT, call it out here.

samir patel: On it. If I hit a blocker I'll nominate a quick 10m sync.

riyad ahmad: merged and published staging artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/staging/sdk/v0.15.0-rc1

maria gonzalez: thanks all. Will post final freeze notice at 15:25 PT here. :hourglass_flowing_sand: If everything stays green we'll proceed with 16:00 cut.

deploy-bot: Freeze window started at 15:30 PT. Tagging sequence will begin at 16:00 PT.
